display.purpose: Largest type in the shell. Same as the page title. No poster scale ships.

headline.purpose: Page titles in the main column, 20px semibold Geist.

body.purpose: App chrome, nav labels, descriptions. 14px regular Geist.

label.purpose: Free chip and compact meta. 12px medium Geist. Not uppercase.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar expands to 240px. Summary docks at 320px. Main and summary sit in a row.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Token-derived primary action. Orange fill, white label, Ink focus ring. No primitive ships yet.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-family: "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 88%, black); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 80%, black); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Token-derived field. White fill, 1px gray stroke, Ink focus ring. No primitive ships yet.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font-family: "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--border); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White surface on the canvas. 12px corners, 1px gray border, no shadow.
components.html:
Summary
White surface on the canvas.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); padding: 24px 0; font-family: "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-header { padding: 0 24px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-card-desc { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

components.name: Amount
components.description: Money and numeric figures. Geist Mono, tabular nums, -0.02em tracking.
components.css: .ds-amount { font-family: "Geist Mono Variable", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--foreground); font-size: 14px; } .ds-amount:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sidebar nav item
components.description: Default Quiet Gray. Active is Wash fill and medium weight, not a colored left border.
components.html: DashboardAccounts
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; font-family: "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted-foreground); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Free chip
components.description: Plan badge. Orange text on a 10% orange wash. Fully round, no border.
components.css: .ds-chip-free { display: inline-block; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 10%, transparent); color: var(--primary); font-family: "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.33; padding: 2px 8px; } .ds-chip-free:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 14%, transparent); } .ds-chip-free:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Progress
components.description: 8px full-round bar. Track is 20% orange. Fill is solid orange.
components.css: .ds-progress { position: relative; height: 8px; width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 20%, transparent); } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; width: 100%; background: var(--primary); transform: translateX(-40%); transition: transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-progress:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sheet / drawer
components.description: Right drawer on canvas. 1px gray left edge. Does not cover the left nav.
components.html:
Details

Create and edit in a right drawer.
components.css: .ds-sheet { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; width: 384px; max-width: 100%; height: 320px; background: var(--background); border-left: 1px solid var(--border); font-family: "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sheet-header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 16px; } .ds-sheet-title { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-sheet-desc { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-sheet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
A well-lit board you read in seconds. The shell is a pale canvas with white cards, one gray hairline, and a single orange accent used on actions, the Free chip, and progress fill. Status arrives as type, charts, and bar fill, not as chrome.

The type is Geist Variable at 14px for UI and 20px semibold for page titles. Geist Mono Variable is reserved for amounts. Light theme only. White cards. Soft gray borders. Rounded corners. Green means on track or income. Red means over budget or overage.

This is not aviation costume, not a spreadsheet, and not a SaaS gradient kit.
keyCharacteristics: Flat depth: off-white canvas, white cards, 1px gray borders, no drop shadows
One accent (orange) for CTAs, Free, and progress. Never for borders
Geist for UI, Geist Mono for numbers only
Desktop-first rail: 240px sidebar, 56px header, right drawer that leaves the nav visible

rules.name: The No-Colored-Border Rule
rules.body: Borders are 1px Hairline Gray. Orange, green, and red never become outlines, left rails, or card strokes.

rules.name: The Status-From-Fill Rule
rules.body: Green and red mark on-track/income and over-budget/overage in type, charts, and progress fill. They are not chrome.

rules.name: The Geist-Only Rule
rules.body: Geist Variable is the UI face. system-ui is fallback only, never the design face. No novelty or display fonts.

rules.name: The Numbers-Are-Mono Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono Variable is for money and numeric amounts via Amount. Never on labels, nav, headings, or body copy.

rules.name: The Board-First Rule
rules.body: Desktop-first. The left nav stays visible. Drawers open from the right and do not cover that rail.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth is canvas vs card, plus 1px gray borders. No card drop shadows. No zero-offset colored halos.

rules.name: The Soft-Corner Rule
rules.body: Cards 12px. Controls 6px. Pills and bars full-round. No sharp tickets, no squircles, no colored radii.

rules.name: The Quiet-Active Rule
rules.body: Active nav is Wash fill and medium weight. Not a colored left border, not orange text, not a pill in Signal Orange.

dos: Do use 1px Hairline Gray on cards, sidebar, header, summary, and drawers.
Do set amounts in Geist Mono with tabular nums and -0.02em tracking via Amount.
Do mark active nav with Wash fill and medium weight.
Do keep cards at 12px corners with no shadow.
Do use Signal Orange on primary actions, the Free chip, and progress fill.
Do keep focus as a 2px Ink outline with a 2px offset.
donts: Don't put colored borders on cards, nav items, callouts, or alerts. No accent `border-left`, no rainbow outlines.
Don't use Geist Mono on labels, nav, or body copy.
Don't set system-ui as the design face.
Don't add card drop shadows or zero-offset colored halos.
Don't use novelty or display fonts. Geist only.
Don't treat orange as a border color.
Don't ship spreadsheet chrome (cell grids, column letters, click-to-edit cells).
